newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Delivery named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Delivery named in lawsuit.

text.p: The law firm of Bernstein Liebhard and Liftshitz said Monday it filed a lawsuit seeking class action status against Consolidated Delivery & Logistics Inc and the company's directors and securities underwriters.
The lawsuit was filed by plaintiff Morris Rubin on behalf of buyers of Consolidated Delivery's common stock from November 21, 1995 to February 27, 1997, the law firm said.

According to the law firm, the plaintiff alleged that the defendants made "material misrepresentations and omissions" in documents filed in connection with the company's initial public offering of stock on Novenber 20, 1995.
Cynthia Gentile, general counsel of the company, said Consolidated Delivery still had not been served court papers and could not therefore make any comment.
Consolidated Delivery is a same-day ground and air delivery and logistics company based in Paramus, N.J.
